contentText: Xi Jinping, Donald Trump and Vladimir Putin opened their first trilateral talks in Shenzhen on the sidelines of the APEC forum, a meeting analysts expect to offer more symbolism than breakthroughs and that critics fear could carve the world into spheres of influence. Ukraine, the Iran war, nuclear disarmament and AI are all expected to come up, while Trump and Xi also held one-on-one talks on trade and technology.
